environment.description: Jenkins-based CI/CD pipeline running on EC2 instances in a public subnet with internet gateway. The BuildConfigParser plugin is invoked when users push XML build configurations via the pipeline API. The service runs with IAM instance profile granting s3:*, secretsmanager:GetSecretValue. IMDS v1 is enabled (no token required). The plugin's strictMode is set to false in production configuration. Outbound traffic is unrestricted (no egress filtering). The XML parser endpoint is exposed on port 8080 via public ALB.

config.network: public subnet with IGW, no egress restrictions
config.imds: IMDSv1 enabled (no hop limit, no token required)
config.alb: internet-facing ALB on port 443 forwarding to 8080
config.security_group: inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0, outbound all traffic allowed
